authority.basis: The issue authorises the smallest new deterministic card, relic or effect primitive after existing grammar fails, and the controlling comment places a new combat representation or persistent run/relic state after the now-exhausted presentation/acquisition fallback without another routine checkpoint.

researchQuestion: After the exact existing-consumer acquisition scalar closes on measured saturation and interference, which one minimum untested representation class can directly encode selective Dusk package commitment without reopening a closed family or breaking save, internal-ID, determinism or RNG contracts?
claimBoundary: This deterministic audit selects at most one representation for a separate design and source-feasibility contract. It does not select numeric payoff values, implement product truth, inspect support, simulate, establish activation or complementarity, authorise a policy method, or cross promotion.

scientificBasis.measuredSaturation: The fixed support panel observed robust intended co-play in 64 of 64 executioner policies and 63 of 64 guardedStrike policies, with zero exact-inactive policies in both arms.
scientificBasis.measuredInterference: The intended active sets had Jaccard 0.984375 and guardedStrike changed 15 preregistered Scoreline anchors.
scientificBasis.measuredSelectorScarcity: The exact current selector chose executioner for 53 policies, guardedStrike for one and decline for ten; it is closed without retune.
scientificBasis.methodBoundary: Broad forced-arm use plus failed intrinsic separation does not give ML, RL or another optimiser decision value. A representation must first make the package choice causally distinct.
scientificBasis.selectionRule: Select only a materially distinct, authority-bounded, deterministic and policy-visible representation that directly addresses all three measured failures, preserves separate Scoreline and Afterimage payoffs, permits an exact null path and uses existing save and string-ID representations without a migration.

options.definition: A new combat-local enum locks the first observed package action for one fight and gates the other package.
options.aliasStructure: It aliases the closed package-order and normalised-payoff commitment grammar, does not provide the missing persistent acquisition choice and cannot address selector scarcity across fights.

options.definition: A new mutable CardInst tag or transform carries a package relation between card instances.
options.aliasStructure: It reopens the generated-card token, transform-state and co-hand families, adds a new card lifecycle, and still supplies no persistent selector semantics.

options.definition: A new RunState field stores a Dusk package commitment directly.
options.aliasStructure: It could address the measured failures but unnecessarily changes the persisted envelope and migration contract when the existing relic string list already represents additive durable state.

options.definition: Represent a Dusk-only Scoreline or Afterimage commitment with one of two additive research relic IDs in the existing saved relic list. The existing ChoiceScreen supplies the deterministic post-Embark choice and the existing deck carries the chosen existing consumer. An Oath may gate only its own package and suppress the opposite package while active; no-Oath preserves exact current behaviour.
options.aliasStructure: This is the untested persistent run/relic class explicitly left after the bounded acquisition fallback. It uses existing persistence rather than reopening an existing relic trigger or the closed acquisition scalar as a standalone treatment.

options.definition: Fit or optimise a new selector over the closed existing-consumer acquisition factor.
options.aliasStructure: The support panel closed the underlying scalar mechanism before exact activation and did not measure method decision value; a new selector would be V39-style rescue rather than a structural representation.

decisionRules.success: All immutable source, evidence and ledger identities pass and exactly one representation satisfies every eligibility field within 30 seconds.
decisionRules.successAuthority: Freeze only the selected representation for one separately preregistered source-feasibility and exact design contract. Do not yet add content IDs, choose names or numeric values, implement, simulate, inspect support, add a policy method, use protected seeds or cross promotion.
decisionRules.futility: No representation satisfies every eligibility field.
decisionRules.futilityAuthority: Record the structural direction unavailable at the zero-row cap and apply the current human-authority contract without proposing an unfrozen candidate or creating a successor ticket.
decisionRules.inconclusive: Any immutable identity, source anchor, partition identity, ledger identity or numeric cap fails, or more than one representation is eligible.
decisionRules.inconclusiveAuthority: Record the audit inconclusive at cap without repair, rerun, selection, implementation, simulator row, method or protected seed.

methodBoundary: No ML, RL, optimiser, random selector, adaptive candidate loop, support read, simulator row, product mutation, PR or Actions is authorised.
